form.label: Audit & authentication
form.description: Trace access, failed logins, configuration changes, and administrative activity.

search.query: `zabbix_events` earliest=-7d | stats count by instance | fields instance

div.p: Trace access, failed logins, configuration changes, and administrative activity.

html.p: Audit collection needs a Zabbix Super admin token with auditlog.get permission and audit logging enabled. API-token use is not a complete access log; forward frontend/proxy and identity-provider logs separately.

search.query: | tstats dc(Audit.event_uid) AS failures FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Security.Audit WHERE Audit.instance=$instance|s$ Audit.action=failed_login
| tstats dc(Audit.event_uid) AS logins FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Security.Audit WHERE Audit.instance=$instance|s$ Audit.action=login
| tstats dc(Audit.event_uid) AS changes FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Security.Audit WHERE Audit.instance=$instance|s$ Audit.category=change

| tstats dc(Audit.event_uid) AS events FROM datamodel=Zabbix_Security.Audit WHERE Audit.instance=$instance|s$ Audit.category=authentication BY _time span=1h Audit.action | rename Audit.action AS action | timechart span=1h sum(events) by action
`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:audit action=failed_login | dedup event_uid | stats count values(user) AS users by src | sort -count

`zabbix_events` instance=$instance|s$ sourcetype=zabbix:audit | dedup event_uid | spath input=_raw path=raw.details output=details | table _time instance user src action resource resource_name recordsetid details | sort -_time
